name: SmartThings
tagline: Samsung smart-home cloud REST API for devices, locations, scenes, and rules
description: SmartThings is Samsung's smart-home platform API for managing devices, locations, rooms, scenes, and automation rules. Resource requests use OAuth 2.0 bearer access tokens. Short-lived personal access tokens are intended for testing and personal use; long-term production integrations use the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow to obtain access and refresh tokens. App client credentials participate in that flow but do not directly authenticate resource requests.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 Bearer token (Personal Access Token or installed-app token) in Authorization header; create PATs at developer.smartthings.com

rate_limits: Published and endpoint-specific. Limits vary by operation; responses include X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers, and exceeding a limit returns HTTP 429.
use_cases: list devices in a SmartThings location
read device capability status (switch, temperature, lock)
execute a device command (turn on/off, set level)
run a scene by scene ID
list locations and rooms for an account
